description.value: As a construct, you have different physiological needs than organic creatures. You don't need to eat, drink, breathe, or sleep. You still need a daily period of rest. During this period of rest, you enter standby mode for 2 hours, which is similar to sleeping except that you're aware of your surroundings and don't take penalties for being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Unconscious].
